A browser form would have to reimplement factory.contracts serialization to match, and any drift yields 422. Surfacing it needs a typed backend draft endpoint rather than a client-side hasher, which is new scope. health/live is a probe, not a UI route.

Source QA findings from the real catalog. The 21,345,746-row January 2025 figure in T51 is reproducible exactly: eight real SOURCE_BID_ASK datasets sum to that. A clean structural scan of the EURUSD January partition (2,283,239 rows) returns source_structural_status PASS, complete_source_scan true and synthetic false.

Two defects found. First, the two retained .pending-* scans in artifacts/source-quality were run against dataset 45d7129e8d25e4, which is the project-generated TEST ONLY rehearsal fixture (USDJPY, September 2025) rather than any real partition, and with a EURUSD January 2025 calendar. The instrument mismatch guard correctly rejected it and the event budget was exhausted; the scans are correctly NOT admitted. Second, no completed source-quality receipt exists at all, and the scan CLI writes no receipt when the calendar is unknown, so failed and partial attempts are only discoverable by listing .pending-* directories. That is the orphan-inventory gap the backlog names, now reproduced.

Three catalog entries have a manifest.json but no quotes.parquet, including two January 2025 AUDUSD entries. The catalog is not self-consistent; nothing currently resolves those hashes.

The host runs TWO state roots with separate catalogs, stores and artifact trees: /var/lib/hermes-factory (359 catalog entries, 2 failed attempts, 0 receipts) and /var/lib/hermes-factory/backfill (0 catalog entries, 1 completed attempt, 1 receipt). A scan run against one root cannot see the other's receipts or pending directories, which is how the two roots drifted apart. This needs an explicit decision on which root is authoritative; nothing currently reconciles them.

requirements.supporting_evidence_scope: Source refresh and storage inventory re-verified against the real acquired catalog on this host. refresh now reports verified 134, mismatched [], missing [], consistent true. A real defect was found and fixed first: refresh treated every manifest as a leaf, so the three composed views (data/view-v1), which by design have no quotes.parquet of their own, were reported as missing and the catalog as inconsistent. It now verifies a view through its leaves, requiring each referenced leaf to exist and match its recorded parquet_sha256, and still reports a view with no parts or with a missing or mismatched leaf. storage reports 17 partitions and 32,868,960 rows across instruments; source-coverage reports 129 observed with scope 'immutable source coverage; not historical approval or complete market coverage'.
